title: 3D Models - SimonDZN
description: Welcome to the texture pack! This pack brings exciting visual customizations to your game and makes your items real eye‑catchers.
body:
This pack brings special features into the game:

Rename Gold Nugget: If you rename a nugget to “traktor” or “schubkarre” and place it in an item frame, a custom model will appear.

Totem of Undying: Now looks like a pink rabbit – a fun little detail for your inventory.

Invisible Item Frames: Your models float freely in the room without any distracting frames.

✨ Make use of these features for creative decorations and unique designs!
